Bug_Title: RANGE: Array offset is out of bounds (RANGE_ARRAY_OFFSET)
Bug_Details: Method is called with array parameter and offset parameter, but the offset is out of bounds. This will result in IndexOutOfBoundsException at runtime.
Bug_Explanation: The `showBug` method takes an array and an offset as arguments. If the offset is greater than the length of the array, an `ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException` is thrown. In the `main` method, an offset of 10 is passed to `showBug`, causing this exception.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case `testShowBugWithInvalidOffset` calls the `showBug` method with an invalid offset of 10, which is out of the bounds of the array `arr` with a length of 5. This triggers the bug in the `showBug` method, causing an `ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException` to be thrown.
